instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Aquaculture operation producing 800 tons of tilapia and seabass annually for export to Southern European markets. Currently expanding hatchery capacity by 40%. Main challenges are feed cost optimization and disease prevention in high-density tanks. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers. Decision-making is fast and informal, but we lack the specialized expertise in-house to evaluate complex technology investments without external advisory support.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration. However, adjacent teams (marketing, support) are still adapting to the faster cadence.
answers.strategicGoals: We aim to double revenue within 3 years by entering 2 new geographic markets and launching a direct-to-consumer channel alongside our existing B2B distribution. Our top priority is identifying scalable customer acquisition channels and building the operational capacity to support rapid volume growth without degrading quality or margins.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 8 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 20%.

opportunities.title: Formalizing Specialized Technical Expertise and R&D Function
opportunities.rationale: The current model relies heavily on generalist developers having spare cycles, which is unsustainable for the targeted rapid growth. To achieve 'double revenue' goals, specialized expertise (e.g., advanced feed optimization modeling or disease pathology) must be formally allocated time and budget to prevent core operational duties from impeding innovation.

first_actions: Allocate dedicated, ring-fenced 10% of developer capacity for R&D over the next quarter.
Define specific technical competency gaps (e.g., predicting outbreak risk based on environmental data) and hire/train staff to fill them.
Establish a formal internal advisory process to evaluate complex tech investments, reducing reliance on 'owner_alone' decision-making for expert input.
resources_needed: Specialized talent acquisition (e.g., aquaculture data scientist)
execution_plan.success_metric: Establishment of a quarterly, measurable R&D roadmap with assigned team leads.
milestones: Pilot the dedicated R&D capacity for 4 weeks.

opportunities.title: Developing Operational Playbook for Multi-Market D2C Launch
opportunities.rationale: The goal to double revenue by entering two new markets and launching D2C is a massive operational undertaking. Instead of ad-hoc planning, the company needs a repeatable playbook that covers logistics, regulatory nuances (even if low overall), e-commerce integration, and localized marketing channels.

first_actions: Map end-to-end customer journey for D2C in target markets, identifying key technology touchpoints.
Engage customs/logistics partners to model shipping requirements and compliance hurdles for the new geography.
Develop a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) sales funnel simulation using existing team members.
resources_needed: E-commerce platform specializing in global reach
Dedicated cross-functional 'Launch Task Force' time commitment
execution_plan.success_metric: Creation of a documented, budgeted operational roadmap for the first target market launch.
milestones: Identify 2 key regulatory/logistical bottlenecks per market.

next_steps.action: Draft a proposal for ring-fenced R&D staffing and budget to transition from generalist prototyping to specialized function.
Form a dedicated cross-functional task force (Sales, Operations, Tech) to map the D2C customer journey and identify necessary tech integrations.
Systemize and formalize the successful agile practices adopted by engineering across Marketing and Support teams to improve cross-functional adaptation.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated, specialized R&D personnel results in innovation happening only during 'spare cycles.'
Over-reliance on the owner for key decisions limits rapid scale and external expertise integration.
Functional silo gaps persist; adjacent teams (Marketing/Support) are struggling to maintain pace with the accelerated agile development cycle.

improvements: Successfully adopted Agile methodology, leading to a 60% reduction in release cycle time.
Launched structured customer feedback channels using NPS surveys.
Increased innovation budget allocation by 3 percentage points (15% to 18%).
persistent_gaps: Structural talent gap remains: No dedicated R&D function means strategic growth is constrained by operational maintenance demands.
The informal nature of decision-making persists, despite clear technical successes.
achieved_milestones: Successful transition to 2-week sprint cycles for core development.
Improved early detection and tracking of customer pain points via NPS.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant organizational improvements were made (Agile adoption, new hires, increased budget), demonstrating execution capability. However, the core barrier—lack of specialized talent/R&D structure—has persisted and must be addressed to meet aggressive growth goals.
